title: GPT-5.2 Pro extends a scattering-amplitude result to gravitons
summary: Building on work on gluons, GPT-5.2 Pro helped derive formulas for nonzero single-minus gravitational amplitudes in a special semi-collinear regime. The authors report analytical verification and checks against known physical limits; this is a theoretical preprint without experimental confirmation.

evidence.tested: The preprint derives explicit formulas for single-minus graviton tree amplitudes in the half-collinear regime and shows they follow from symmetry principles and recursion relations; no experimental test is described.
evidence.unknown: The page calls it a small step towards reconciling quantum mechanics with general relativity.
evidence.ai_role: Researchers used GPT-5.2 Pro to help find the result; the paper is authored by named physicists on behalf of OpenAI.
